title: Monotonicity of space use
statement: Let $M$ be a Turing machine with $k$ work tapes over the Boolean alphabet, let $c$ be a configuration for a Boolean input string, and let $t,t'\in\mathbb{N}$ with $t\le t'$. The total number of distinct work-tape cells visited from $c$ through step $t$ is at most the number visited through step $t'$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A machine over Bool with state type $S$
A Boolean input list and configuration for that input
